title: Complete Light Theme Transformation with Premium Banarasi Aesthetics

requirements.summary: Replace all dark theme colors throughout the application with premium light theme palette including soft warm ivory backgrounds, antique gold accents, deep charcoal text, and pure white cards with gold borders
acceptanceCriteria: No navy blue or black backgrounds visible anywhere in the application
All backgrounds use ivory (#F8F5F0) or beige gradient (#F8F5F0 → #F5F0E6)
Primary text is deep charcoal gray (#1A1A1A) with excellent contrast
All buttons use antique gold background (#C9A96E) with dark text
Product cards are pure white (#FFFFFF) with 1px gold borders
Hover effects show warm gold glow (box-shadow with rgba(201,169,110,0.45))

file_operations.description: Replace all dark theme CSS variables with light theme palette: set --background to #F8F5F0 (soft warm ivory), --foreground to #1A1A1A (deep charcoal), --primary to #C9A96E (antique gold), --primary-foreground to #1A1A1A, --secondary to #E8C0C8 (muted blush rose gold), --secondary-foreground to #1A1A1A, --accent to #C9A96E, --accent-foreground to #1A1A1A, --card to #FFFFFF (pure white), --card-foreground to #1A1A1A, --muted to #F5F0E6 (very light beige), --muted-foreground to #5C4B51 (warm taupe gray), --border to #C9A96E, and remove all dark mode @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) blocks. Update global body styles to use the ivory background. Ensure all theme variables reference the new light palette consistently.

Update Tailwind theme configuration to reflect the new light theme color palette: replace existing plum/navy values with ivory (#F8F5F0), antique gold (#C9A96E, #D4B37D), blush rose gold (#E8C0C8), deep charcoal (#1A1A1A), warm taupe (#5C4B51), very light beige (#F5F0E6), and pure white (#FFFFFF). Remove any dark mode variants or extend configuration with light-only colors. Update boxShadow utilities to include warm gold glow effects using rgba(201,169,110,0.45) for hover states.

Replace purple gradient background with soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0) background. Update text colors to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) for excellent readability. Replace gold zari pattern overlay with subtle warm beige gradient or remove if not needed. Update navigation link hover states to show antique gold (#C9A96E) color and warm gold glow effect. Ensure cart badge uses antique gold background with dark text.

Update product cards to use pure white (#FFFFFF) background with 1px solid gold border (#C9A96E). Add soft shadow effect. On hover, add warm gold box-shadow (0 0 18px rgba(201,169,110,0.45)) for glow effect with lift transform. Update text colors to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) for product names and prices. Update 'Add to Cart' button background to antique gold (#C9A96E) with dark text (#1A1A1A) and hover effects (deeper gold, scale, glow).

Replace any dark backgrounds with soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update section backgrounds to use very light beige gradient (#F8F5F0 → #F5F0E6) where applicable. Ensure all text uses deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) for readability. Update the generated logo reference to use frontend/public/assets/generated/doraa-logo-gold.dim_400x120.png centered at the top. Verify all child components inherit the light theme styling.

Update category navigation bar background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0) or transparent. Update category text colors to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Add hover effects with antique gold (#C9A96E) background and warm gold glow. Ensure scrollable behavior on mobile remains intact with light theme styling.

Replace purple gradient background with soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0) or very light beige gradient (#F8F5F0 → #F5F0E6). Update gold wave transitions to use antique gold (#C9A96E) tones. Remove any dark overlays or replace with subtle light overlays. Ensure text visibility with deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) color and proper contrast.

Replace any dark backgrounds with soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0) or very light beige gradient. Update all text to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) for primary text and warm taupe gray (#5C4B51) for secondary text. Update link hover states to antique gold (#C9A96E) with warm glow effect.

Update dashboard background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update card backgrounds to pure white (#FFFFFF) with 1px gold borders. Update tab styling to use antique gold (#C9A96E) for active tabs. Update all text to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) for headings and primary text, warm taupe (#5C4B51) for secondary text. Update 'Save Changes' button to antique gold background with dark text and hover effects.

Update cart panel background to pure white (#FFFFFF) or soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update item cards to pure white with 1px gold borders. Update text colors to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Update checkout button to antique gold background (#C9A96E) with dark text and hover effects (deeper gold, scale, warm glow).

Update checkout form background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update input field backgrounds to pure white (#FFFFFF) with 1px gold borders (#C9A96E). Update label text to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Update submit button to antique gold background with dark text and premium hover effects.

Update quick view sheet background to pure white (#FFFFFF) or soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update text colors to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Update action buttons to antique gold background with dark text and hover effects. Ensure gold borders and warm glow effects are consistent with the light theme.

Update product detail modal background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update product information card to pure white (#FFFFFF) with 1px gold border. Update all text to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Update 'Add to Cart' and wishlist buttons to antique gold styling with dark text and hover effects.

Update products page background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update product grid container styling. Ensure all ProductCard components render with light theme styling (pure white cards, gold borders, warm glow on hover). Update loading skeleton colors to match light theme palette.

Update login page background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update form card background to pure white (#FFFFFF) with 1px gold border. Update input fields to white background with gold borders. Update all text to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Update submit buttons to antique gold background with dark text and hover effects. Ensure OTP input fields and tab styling match the light theme.

Update Banarasi collection section background to very light beige gradient (#F8F5F0 → #F5F0E6). Update decorative header text to antique gold (#C9A96E). Update product cards to pure white with gold borders. Ensure carousel navigation controls use antique gold styling with hover effects.

Update quick details overlay background to pure white (#FFFFFF) with subtle shadow. Update text colors to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) for primary info and warm taupe (#5C4B51) for secondary details. Update accent colors to antique gold (#C9A96E) and blush rose gold (#E8C0C8).

Update trending categories section background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update category cards to pure white with 1px gold borders. Update text to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Add warm gold glow hover effects to category cards.

Update admin dashboard background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update metrics cards to pure white (#FFFFFF) with 1px gold borders. Update text to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Update accent colors to antique gold (#C9A96E).

Update admin layout background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update sidebar background to very light beige (#F5F0E6). Update navigation link styling to use antique gold for active states. Update header text to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A).

Update admin products page background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update product list cards to pure white with gold borders. Update action buttons to antique gold background with dark text and hover effects.

Replace dark ocean animation with a light-themed ambient background. Use soft warm ivory tones, pearl shimmer effects, and subtle beige gradients. Adjust wave colors to light gold and cream hues. Ensure the animation respects reduced motion preferences and complements the light theme palette.

Update pearl shimmer particles to use antique gold (#C9A96E) and blush rose gold (#E8C0C8) colors with glow effects that complement the light theme background. Ensure particles are visible against soft warm ivory backgrounds.

Update empty state background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update text colors to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) for primary messages and warm taupe (#5C4B51) for secondary text. Update CTA buttons to antique gold background with dark text and hover effects.
Update error state background to soft warm ivory (#F8F5F0). Update text colors to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A). Update retry button to antique gold background with dark text and hover effects.

requirements.summary: Update typography throughout the application to use premium luxury fonts: Playfair Display ExtraBold for headings with antique gold color and letter-spacing, Great Vibes script for category names, Lora Regular for body text, and Montserrat Bold for buttons

Category names use Great Vibes script font at 2.8-3.8rem size
All body text uses Lora Regular with line-height 1.9-2.1
All buttons use Montserrat Bold or Raleway ExtraBold in all caps
Letter-spacing on headings is 2-4px
Typography renders consistently on all devices

file_operations.description: Verify and ensure Google Fonts preconnect links include Playfair Display (weight 800), Great Vibes (Regular), Lora (Regular 400), Montserrat (Bold 700), and Raleway (ExtraBold 800). Update existing links if necessary to include all required font weights.

Create utility classes for script font (Great Vibes) and button font (Montserrat Bold or Raleway ExtraBold) in all caps.

Set default sans-serif to Lora for body text. Update fontSize configuration to include script font sizes (2.8rem, 3rem, 3.8rem). Add letterSpacing utilities for 2px, 3px, and 4px.

Update navigation link font to Montserrat Bold or Raleway ExtraBold if applicable. Ensure text sizing uses clamp() for responsive scaling.

Update main headings to use Playfair Display ExtraBold with antique gold color and letter-spacing 2-4px. Update body text to Lora Regular with line-height 1.9-2.1 and deep charcoal color. Update 'Save Changes' button text to use Montserrat Bold or Raleway ExtraBold in all caps.

Update footer headings to use Playfair Display ExtraBold with antique gold color if applicable. Update body text and links to use Lora Regular with line-height 1.9-2.1 and appropriate colors (deep charcoal for primary, warm taupe for secondary).

requirements.summary: Implement Vastrado-style home page layout with centered gold luxury DoRaa Sangam House logo at top, horizontal category navigation bar below logo, user profile/dashboard icon on right, and product grid below navigation with on-model images and styled cards
acceptanceCriteria: Logo is centered at top in gold luxury styling
Horizontal category bar displays all specified categories
Category navigation scrolls smoothly on mobile
Profile/dashboard icon is visible on the right
Product grid displays below navigation
Product cards show image, name, price, discount badge, and Add to Cart button
Cards have curved corners, white background, and lift on hover
Gold border appears on card hover

file_operations.description: Restructure home page layout to implement Vastrado-style design. At the top center, display the generated gold luxury logo (frontend/public/assets/generated/doraa-logo-gold.dim_400x120.png) with proper sizing and responsive behavior. Below the logo, integrate the CategoryNavigationBar component displaying categories (Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All) in a horizontal scrollable layout. Position the user profile/dashboard icon on the right side of the navigation bar or header. Below the navigation, display a grid of product cards showing on-model images (use existing product data with images from assets), product name, price, discount badge, and 'Add to Cart' button. Ensure proper spacing and alignment with the light theme palette.

Ensure CategoryNavigationBar displays all specified categories (Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All) in a horizontal layout with smooth scrolling on mobile. Update styling to match the light theme with Great Vibes script font for category names at 2.8-3.8rem size. Add overflow-x-auto for mobile scrollability. Ensure hover effects show antique gold color and warm glow.

Add or ensure the user profile/dashboard icon is positioned on the right side of the header. Icon should be visible and clickable, opening the dashboard or user menu. Use antique gold color for the icon with hover effects. Ensure proper spacing and alignment with the logo and navigation elements.

Ensure product cards display on-model images (from assets), product name, price, discount badge, and 'Add to Cart' button. Apply curved corners (border-radius), pure white background (#FFFFFF), and 1px gold border (#C9A96E). Add hover effect with lift transform (translateY) and warm gold box-shadow glow (0 0 18px rgba(201,169,110,0.45)). Ensure all text uses the correct typography (Lora for names/descriptions, Montserrat Bold for buttons). Discount badge should use antique gold or blush rose gold styling.

requirements.summary: Update dashboard with Profile, Orders, and Addresses tabs, add Appearance section with theme switcher showing Light as default and only active option, and display user details with Save Changes button
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard has Profile, Orders, and Addresses tabs
Appearance section is visible with theme switcher
Light theme option is active and selected by default
Dark and System options are disabled or hidden
User details form shows name, email, and phone fields
Save Changes button is present and functional

file_operations.description: Ensure dashboard displays three tabs: Profile, Orders, and Addresses. Under the Profile tab, add an 'Appearance' section with theme switcher buttons. Display Light theme option as active and selected by default with antique gold styling. Disable or hide Dark and System options (gray out or remove from UI). Below the Appearance section, display user details form with fields for name, email, and phone. Add a 'Save Changes' button styled with antique gold background, dark text, and hover effects. Ensure all styling matches the light theme palette with Playfair Display for headings, Lora for body text, and Montserrat Bold for buttons.

Update ThemeSwitcher component to show Light theme option as active and selected by default with antique gold highlighting. Disable or hide Dark and System options (apply disabled styling or remove buttons entirely). Ensure the component respects the light-only theme requirement and does not allow switching to dark mode. Update styling to match the light theme palette with pure white card background and gold accents.

requirements.summary: Ensure 100% consistent appearance across laptop, mobile, and tablet devices with no media-query overrides for colors, fonts, or backgrounds, using rem units and clamp() for responsive scaling, and smooth premium hover animations
acceptanceCriteria: Colors, fonts, and backgrounds are identical on laptop, mobile, and tablet
No media queries override the light theme colors or typography
All spacing uses rem units
Font sizes use clamp() for fluid responsive scaling
Hover animations work smoothly with warm gold glow and lift effects
Reduced motion preferences are respected
No responsiveness issues or layout breaks on any device

file_operations.description: Remove all @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) blocks and any media query overrides that change colors, fonts, or backgrounds for different screen sizes. Ensure all color variables remain consistent across all devices. Update spacing to use rem units throughout. Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rules to disable or simplify animations for users who prefer reduced motion. Verify that CSS variables are device-agnostic and maintain the light theme palette across all viewports.

Ensure no responsive variants override light theme colors or typography. Update fontSize configuration to use clamp() for fluid responsive scaling (e.g., clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem)). Ensure spacing utilities use rem units. Add motion-safe and motion-reduce variants for animations to respect user preferences. Verify that all theme colors remain consistent across breakpoints.

Ensure hover animations (warm gold glow, lift effect, scale) work smoothly across all devices. Use CSS transitions with appropriate timing functions (ease-out). Wrap animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) to respect reduced motion preferences. Use rem units for padding and margins. Use clamp() for responsive font sizes.

Use rem units for all spacing and sizing. Use clamp() for responsive font sizes in brand name and navigation links. Ensure hover effects (antique gold color, warm glow) use transitions that respect reduced motion preferences. Remove any media queries that override light theme colors.

Use clamp() for responsive font sizes in category names (2.8rem to 3.8rem range). Use rem units for spacing and padding. Ensure smooth scrolling behavior on mobile without media query color overrides. Hover effects should respect reduced motion preferences.

Use rem units for all spacing, margins, and padding. Use clamp() for responsive typography. Ensure grid layout uses responsive units (fr, %, rem) without media query overrides for colors or fonts. Verify animations respect reduced motion preferences.

Use rem units for all spacing. Use clamp() for responsive font sizes in headings and body text. Ensure tabs, forms, and buttons scale properly across devices without media query overrides for light theme colors. Button hover effects should respect reduced motion preferences.

Use rem units for spacing and typography. Use clamp() for responsive font sizes. Ensure three-column grid layout adapts responsively using CSS Grid with fr units. Remove any media queries that override light theme colors or fonts.

Verify this hook correctly detects prefers-reduced-motion media query and returns a boolean. Ensure it is imported and used in all animation-heavy components (ProductCard, CinematicHeroSlider, BanarasiShowcaseAmbience, OceanBackground, etc.) to conditionally disable or simplify animations.
